verdict.rationale: Thoropass documents its own auditor-vetted native integrations catalog that collects compliance data automatically, and its connected-tools docs name cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP) that monitors check. The evidence does not show the other categories in the story or any read-only permission model. Missing for 10: evidence of identity, HR, code-hosting, MDM and ticketing integrations; documentation of read-only scopes/permissions; independent or hands-on corroboration of the catalog's breadth.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can connect my real stack — cloud providers, identity, HR, code hosting, MDM, ticketing — through a documented integrations catalog with read-only scopes

citations.quote: Connect your business tools and apps to Thoropass via our auditor-vetted native integrations.
Monitors automatically check your connected systems (such as AWS, Azure, or GCP) for compliance with the control's requirements.
Thoropass integrations are vetted and approved by auditors. High-quality data automatically satisfies evidence requests while powering transparent continuous compliance monitors.
Thoropass collects compliance-relevant data automatically, keeping you audit-ready and alerting you to compliance violations
